source: Cypress Documentation - Retry-ability - https://docs.cypress.io/app/core-concepts/retry-ability; Cypress Documentation - Error Messages in Cypress - https://docs.cypress.io/app/references/error-messages
statement: Cypress automatically retries the queries and assertions surrounding a command until they pass or a timeout elapses, but the action command itself (e.g. .click() or .type()) executes only once, after built-in actionability checks confirm the element can be interacted with - the action is not itself retried, only those checks are. An error stating an element 'cannot be interacted with' reflects a failed actionability check on that one-shot action step, not a failing query or assertion, and should be diagnosed against the application's current state rather than treated as a generic retry/timeout exhaustion.
